www.nvsos.gov.es: la Secretaría de Estado de Nevada

www.leg.state.nv.us.es: la ley electoral de Nevada (capítulo 293 de los NRS)

www.clarkcountynv.gov.es: el Departamento Electoral del condado de Clark (Election Department)

reg_deadline.en: Standard registration by mail or at the county clerk closed October 6, 2026. You can still register online through Election Day, November 3, or in person at an early voting site or a polling place on Election Day.
reg_deadline.es: El registro regular por correo o en la oficina del secretario del condado (county clerk) cerró el 6 de octubre de 2026. Todavía puedes registrarte en línea hasta el Día de las Elecciones, el 3 de noviembre, o en persona en un lugar de votación anticipada o en un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.
reg_deadline.quote: By computer using the system established by the Secretary of State pursuant to NRS 293.671 , is the day of the primary election, presidential preference primary election or general election.

mail_request.notes: Nevada mails a ballot to every active registered voter; there is no request deadline.

mail_return.en: Drop it at a drop box or your county clerk by 7 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, when polls close. By mail: postmarked on or before November 3 and received by 5 p.m. on Saturday, November 7, 2026. The Secretary of State recommends mailing it at least a week before Election Day.
mail_return.es: Déjala en un buzón de entrega o con el secretario de tu condado a más tardar a las 7 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre, cuando cierran los lugares de votación. Por correo: con matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y recibida a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del sábado 7 de noviembre de 2026. La Secretaría de Estado recomienda enviarla por lo menos una semana antes del Día de las Elecciones.
mail_return.quote: (1) Postmarked on or before the day of the election; and (2) Received by the clerk not later than 5 p.m. on the fourth day following the election.

early_hours.en: Each county sets its own hours. Permanent early voting sites are open at least 8 hours a day Monday to Friday and at least 4 hours on Saturdays. Sundays are up to the county.
early_hours.es: Cada condado fija su horario. Los centros permanentes de votación anticipada abren por lo menos 8 horas al día de lunes a viernes y por lo menos 4 horas los sábados. Los domingos dependen del condado.
early_hours.quote: On Monday through Friday during the period for early voting, for at least 8 hours during such hours as the county clerk may establish.

cure.en: Forgot to sign your mail ballot envelope, or your county questions your signature? You have until 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9, 2026, to sign it or confirm it's yours.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar el sobre de tu boleta por correo o tu condado tiene dudas sobre tu firma? Tienes hasta las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre de 2026 para firmarlo o confirmar que es tuya.
cure.quote: For the mail ballot to be counted, the voter must provide a signature or a confirmation, as applicable, not later than 5 p.m. on the sixth day following the election.

in_person.en: Nevada mails you a ballot, but you can still vote in person during early voting or on Election Day. If you already have a mail ballot, bring it to surrender, or sign a statement that you haven't voted. Registering at the polls? Bring a current Nevada driver's license or DMV ID card. If it doesn't show your current address, also bring a document that does, such as a utility bill or bank statement. You may vote a provisional ballot.
in_person.es: Nevada te envía una boleta por correo, pero igual puedes votar en persona durante la votación anticipada o el Día de las Elecciones. Si ya tienes una boleta por correo, llévala para entregarla, o firma una declaración de que no has votado. ¿Te vas a registrar en el lugar de votación? Lleva una licencia de conducir o una tarjeta de identificación vigente del DMV de Nevada. Si no muestra tu dirección actual, lleva también un documento que sí la muestre, como un recibo de servicios o un estado de cuenta bancario. Es posible que votes con una boleta provisional.
in_person.quote: (c) Except as otherwise provided in subsection 3, provide his or her current and valid drivers license or identification card issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles which shows his or her physical address as proof of the electors identity and residency. 3. If the drivers license or identification card issued by the Department of Motor Vehicles to the elector does not have the electors current residential address, the following documents may be used to establish the residency of the elector ... (3) Must vote by casting a provisional ballot, unless it is verified, at that time, that the elector is qualified to register to vote and to cast a regular ballot in the election at that polling place.
in_person.notes: NRS 293.5842 (early voting) and 293.5847 (Election Day). Dropped the vote-center sentence to keep the fact short; its old quote is NRS 293.3072. Clark County's 2026 guide also accepts a Nevada DMV interim document and a Nevada Tribal ID for same-day registration (2025 law the NRS page may lag).

first_time.en: Registered or updated your registration online on or after October 21? You'll vote in person, at an early voting site or an Election Day polling place. Tell the poll worker you registered online before you came.
first_time.es: ¿Te registraste o actualizaste tu registro en línea el 21 de octubre o después? Vas a votar en persona, en un lugar de votación anticipada o en un lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones. Dile al trabajador electoral que te registraste en línea antes de llegar.
first_time.quote: If an elector submits an application to register to vote pursuant to this section less than 14 days before the election, the elector may vote only in person:
first_time.notes: Less than 14 days before the November 3 election means October 21 or later.

locator_label.en: 2026 voting locations and drop boxes (Nevada Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Lugares de votación y buzones de 2026 (Secretaría de Estado de Nevada)

rule.en: The Secretary of State's map shows every early voting site, Election Day polling place and official drop box in the state. Each county also posts its own list.
rule.es: El mapa de la Secretaría de Estado muestra todos los centros de votación anticipada, los lugares de votación del Día de las Elecciones y los buzones oficiales del estado. Cada condado también publica su propia lista.
rule.quote: The following link (also provided here) connects to an interactive map of Nevada with every 2026 General Election polling place during Early Voting and Election Day, as well as all Official Mail Ballot Drop Box locations.

en: A current and valid photo ID that shows your physical address
A government document or check with your name and address (a voter registration card doesn't count)
es: Una identificación con foto vigente y válida que muestre tu domicilio
Un documento o cheque del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección (la tarjeta de registro de votante no cuenta)
accepted.quote: A copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, paycheck, or document issued by a governmental entity, including a check which indicates the name and address of the person, but not including a voter registration card

expired.en: Most voters just sign. ID is for some first-time voters who registered by mail or online and haven't voted for a federal office in Nevada before. A photo ID has to be current and valid.
expired.es: La mayoría de los votantes solo firman. La identificación es para algunos votantes nuevos que se registraron por correo o en línea y que nunca han votado por un cargo federal en Nevada. Una identificación con foto debe estar vigente y ser válida.
expired.quote: A current and valid photo identification of the person, which shows his or her physical address

without.en: If you're asked for ID and don't have it, you can vote a provisional ballot. To have it counted, give the ID to your county clerk by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6, 2026.
without.es: Si te piden una identificación y no la tienes, puedes votar con una boleta provisional. Para que cuente, entrega la identificación a la secretaría de tu condado (county clerk) a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre de 2026.
without.quote: A voter who failed to provide required identification at the polling place or with his or her mailed ballot provides the required identification to the county or city clerk not later than 5 p.m. on the Friday following election day

who.en: Nevada mails a ballot to every active registered voter, and to anyone who registered or updated their registration by October 20, unless they opted out. No request needed. In Clark County, if yours didn't come by October 16, call (702) 455-8683.
who.es: Nevada envía por correo una boleta a cada votante registrado activo, y a quien se registró o actualizó su registro a más tardar el 20 de octubre, salvo que haya pedido no recibirla. No tienes que pedirla. En el condado de Clark, si no te llegó a más tardar el 16 de octubre, llama al (702) 455-8683.
who.quote: the county clerk shall prepare and distribute to each active registered voter in the county and each person who registers to vote or updates his or her voter registration information not later than the 14 days before the election a mail ballot for every election.
who.notes: Clark County 2026 guide: 'If you do not receive your mail ballot packet by October 16, 2026, and wish to vote by mail, immediately contact us at: (702) 455-VOTE (8683)'. Opt-out must be at least 60 days before Election Day (same guide), so it isn't an option for this election.

witness.en: If you have a disability, are 65 or older, or can't read or write, someone can help you mark and sign your ballot. They note next to the signature that they signed for you, or put their name, address and signature on the return envelope if they helped.
witness.es: Si tienes una discapacidad, tienes 65 años o más, o no sabes leer ni escribir, alguien puede ayudarte a marcar y firmar tu boleta. Esa persona indica junto a la firma que firmó por ti, o pone su nombre, dirección y firma en el sobre de devolución si te ayudó.
witness.quote: If a person assists a voter to mark and sign a mail ballot pursuant to this section, the person or the voter must include on the return envelope his or her name, address and signature.

cure.en: If you didn't sign, or your signature doesn't match, your county clerk will contact you by mail, by phone if they have your number, and by email if you gave it. Fix it by 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9. The Secretary of State's Signature Cure page links to each county's online cure tool.
cure.es: Si no firmaste, o tu firma no coincide, la secretaría de tu condado se comunicará contigo por correo, por teléfono si tiene tu número y por correo electrónico si lo diste. Corrígelo a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre. La página de corrección de firmas (Signature Cure) de la Secretaría de Estado tiene el enlace a la herramienta en línea de cada condado.
cure.quote: Select your county below to access the approved online signature cure resource. The deadline to cure a mail ballot for the November 3, 2026, General Election is by 5 p.m. PT, November 9, 2026.
cure.notes: How the clerk contacts you: NRS 293.269927. Read in Chrome (nvsos.gov blocks curl).

dropbox.en: Every early voting site and Election Day polling place takes mail ballots, but only while it's open. You can drop your ballot at any official drop box in your county until polls close at 7 p.m. on Election Day. Check your county's list for each location's hours.
dropbox.es: Todos los lugares de votación anticipada y del Día de las Elecciones reciben boletas por correo, pero solo mientras están abiertos. Puedes dejar tu boleta en cualquier buzón oficial de tu condado hasta que cierren los lugares de votación, a las 7 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones. Revisa la lista de tu condado para ver el horario de cada lugar.
dropbox.quote: Ballots can also be dropped off at any official dropbox in your county up to the close of polls on Election Day.
dropbox.notes: Clark County 2026 guide: 'Any early voting site, October 17-30, 2026, only during voting hours' and 'Any Election Day vote center, Tuesday, November 3, 2026, only 7am-7pm'.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons and badges at home. Wearing a badge, button or other item that names a party, candidate or ballot question counts as electioneering, which isn't allowed inside a polling place or within 100 feet of the building's entrance.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones e insignias de campaña. Llevar una insignia, un botón u otro artículo que nombre a un partido, un candidato o una pregunta de la boleta cuenta como propaganda electoral, y no se permite dentro de un lugar de votación ni a menos de 100 pies de la entrada del edificio.
gear.quote: Buying, selling, wearing or displaying any badge, button or other insigne which expressly refers to any political party or a candidate or ballot question to be voted upon at that election

phone.en: Take your sticker selfie outside. Nevada law bars the public from photographing or recording voting at a polling place. At home, the law lets you show your own mail ballot to others.
phone.es: Tómate la selfie con tu sticker afuera. La ley de Nevada prohíbe que el público tome fotos o grabe la votación en un lugar de votación. En casa, la ley te permite mostrarles a otros tu propia boleta por correo.
phone.quote: A member of the general public shall not photograph the conduct of voting at a polling place or record the conduct of voting on audiotape or any other means of sound or video reproduction. ... (e) Show his or her ballot to another person, after voting, so as to reveal any of his or her votes on the ballot, other than on his or her mail ballot or military-overseas ballot prepared by or on behalf of the voter with his or her authorization pursuant to this title.

line.en: In line when polls close at 7 p.m.? Stay in line. You have the right to vote, during early voting and on Election Day.
line.es: ¿Estás en la fila cuando cierran los lugares de votación a las 7 p. m.? Quédate en la fila. Tienes derecho a votar, tanto en la votación anticipada como el Día de las Elecciones.
line.quote: To vote during any period for early voting or on election day if the voter is waiting in line to vote or register to vote at a polling place at which the voter is entitled to vote or register to vote at the time that the polls close

tradition.en: For Election Day 2024, Allegiant Stadium was an official Clark County polling place, and voters who cast a ballot there got an "I VOTED" sticker made by the Las Vegas Raiders.
tradition.es: El Día de las Elecciones de 2024, el Allegiant Stadium fue un lugar de votación oficial del condado de Clark, y quienes votaron ahí recibieron un sticker de "I VOTED" hecho por los Las Vegas Raiders.
tradition.quote: Allegiant Stadium will serve as an official polling location for Clark County voters on Election Day, November 5th, 2024. The Las Vegas Raiders created an exclusive “I VOTED” sticker for voters who cast their ballot at Allegiant Stadium on Election Day.
tradition.notes: Secretary of State news release, September 27, 2024 (read in Chrome). Not confirmed for 2026. EAC 2019 sticker awards to Clark, Douglas and Washoe are federal (eac.gov), not used.

early.en: In Clark County, the 2026 voter guide's in-person steps, for early voting October 17 to 30 and on Election Day, end with getting your "I Voted" sticker at the tabulator. Other counties set their own practice.
early.es: En el condado de Clark, los pasos para votar en persona de la guía de 2026, para la votación anticipada del 17 al 30 de octubre y el Día de las Elecciones, terminan con recibir tu sticker de "I Voted" en la máquina tabuladora. Los demás condados deciden por su cuenta.

provisional.en: It's a ballot you vote when something can't be confirmed at the polls. Your county clerk counts it after checking that you're registered and eligible. If it was for missing ID, give the ID to the clerk by 5 p.m. on Friday, November 6.
provisional.es: Es una boleta con la que votas cuando algo no se puede confirmar en el lugar de votación. La secretaría de tu condado la cuenta después de revisar que estás registrado y que puedes votar. Si fue por falta de identificación, entrega la identificación a la secretaría a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del viernes 6 de noviembre.
provisional.quote: The county or city clerk determines that the person who cast the provisional ballot was registered to vote in the election, eligible to vote in the election and issued the appropriate ballot for the address at which the person resides

line.en: Stay in line. If you're waiting in line when polls close, you have the right to vote.
line.es: Quédate en la fila. Si estás esperando en la fila cuando cierran los lugares de votación, tienes derecho a votar.
line.quote: To vote during any period for early voting or on election day if the voter is waiting in line to vote or register to vote at a polling place at which the voter is entitled to vote or register to vote at the time that the polls close

track.en: Track your mail ballot at MyBallot.NV.gov.
track.es: Rastrea tu boleta por correo en MyBallot.NV.gov.
track.quote: BALLOT TRACKING: Track your mail ballot on MyBallot.NV.gov

unsigned.en: Your county clerk will contact you by mail, and by phone or email if they have them, so you can sign. Do it by 5 p.m. on Monday, November 9, or your ballot won't count. Your county's online cure tool is linked from the Secretary of State's Signature Cure page.
unsigned.es: La secretaría de tu condado se comunicará contigo por correo, y por teléfono o correo electrónico si los tiene, para que firmes. Hazlo a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del lunes 9 de noviembre, o tu boleta no contará. La herramienta en línea de tu condado está en la página de corrección de firmas (Signature Cure) de la Secretaría de Estado.
unsigned.quote: For the mail ballot to be counted, the voter must provide a signature or a confirmation, as applicable, not later than 5 p.m. on the sixth day following the election.

late_mail.en: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked on or before November 3 and reaches your county clerk by 5 p.m. on November 7. The Secretary of State recommends mailing it at least a week ahead, so in the last week, use a drop box.
late_mail.es: Una boleta por correo cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llega al secretario de tu condado a más tardar a las 5 p. m. del 7 de noviembre. La Secretaría de Estado recomienda enviarla por lo menos una semana antes, así que en la última semana usa un buzón de entrega.
late_mail.quote: The Secretary of State's Office recommends mailing your ballot back at least a week before Election Day.

notes: Read October 21, 2026. nvsos.gov blocks automated fetching, so its pages (2026 Election Information, 2026 Polling Locations, Mail Ballot Voting, Elections FAQ) were read in Chrome; everything else is NRS chapter 293 on leg.state.nv.us (includes 2025 amendments): 293.560 registration, 293.269911 mail ballots to all active voters, 293.269919 assistance, 293.269921 return and drop boxes, 293.269927 signature cure (5 p.m. sixth day = Nov. 9), 293.3568 early voting hours, 293.3072 vote centers, 293.2725 first-time ID, 293.3085 provisional (ID by Friday = Nov. 6), 293.740 electioneering, 293.274 photography, 293.2546 line rule, 293.5837 online registrants inside 14 days. Day-of-week math: fourth day after Nov. 3 = Saturday Nov. 7; sixth = Monday Nov. 9. The SOS FAQ also says postmarked ballots may arrive until 5 p.m. on the fourth day (citing NRS 293.317). Sticker tradition not found on an official page. UPDATE Oct 28, 2026: nvsos.gov blocks curl; read in Chrome. Mail ballot to active voters and anyone registered by Oct 20 (NRS 293.269911), same-day ID (NRS 293.5842), own mail ballot may be shown (NRS 293.730(1)(e)), cure page, Allegiant sticker. Elko County lists some sites (West Wendover, per Perplexity also Owyhee, Jackpot) on Mountain Time: not checked against Elko's own page.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: 1. Except as otherwise provided in NRS 293.305, at all elections held under the provisions of this title, the polls must open at 7 a.m. and close at 7 p.m.
